---
title: LAI 2014-present (raster 300 m), global, 10-daily – version 1
---
### About
Defined as half the total area of green elements of the canopy per unit horizontal ground area. Every 10-days estimates are available in near real time at global scale in the spatial resolution of about 300 m from January 2014 to June 2020 based upon PROBA-V data with version 1.0 and from July 2020 onwards based upon Sentinel-3/OLCI data with version 1.1.

[View this dataset in Copernicus Browser](https://browser.dataspace.copernicus.eu/?zoom=9&lat=46.02622&lng=14.5253&themeId=DEFAULT-THEME&datasetId=COPERNICUS_CLMS_FAPAR_300M_10DAILY&fromTime=2014-01-01T00%3A00%3A00.000Z&toTime=2025-06-12T14:36:02.076559&layerId=FAPAR&demSource3D=%22MAPZEN%22&cloudCoverage=30&dateMode=SINGLE&clmsSelectedPath=Vegetation%20Properties&clmsSelectedCollection=COPERNICUS_CLMS_FAPAR_300M_10DAILY)
